archetypes.name: dyn-cursor-env
archetypes.rationale: Cursor spawn environment is the core regression surface.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed /design plan auto-fix Cursor lane. Verify cursor_auth_export_env runs before the run-external-agent spawn and that the test would fail if the spawned process env lacked NO_OPEN_BROWSER=1. Check that Codex behavior and Cursor argv ordering remain unchanged. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
